ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the collector ingested this record into MAAS

reportName.description: Name of the source Databudget CSV report the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Folder path of the source Databudget report file

type.description: Product type from the 'TYPE' column of the Databudget CSV

num_day.description: Expected number of products per day from the '#Num/day' column

level.description: Processing level from the 'Level' column ('AUX' for the auxiliary databudget)

timeliness.description: Timeliness from the 'Timeliness' column ('AUX' for the auxiliary databudget)

produced.description: Expected produced volume/count from the 'P' column

archived.description: Expected archived volume/count from the 'A' column

disseminated.description: Expected disseminated volume/count from the 'D' column

volume_day.description: Expected volume per day in GB from the 'Volume per day [GB]' column

mission.description: Mission from the 'Mission' column of the Databudget CSV
